ud7.5:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud7.5:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā lakuṇṭhakabhaddiyo sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami.
ud7.5:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ lakuṇṭhakabhaddiyaṃ dūratova sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito āgacchantaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ duddassikaṃ okoṭimakaṃ yebhuyyena bhikkhūnaṃ paribhūtarūpaṃ
ud7.5:3.1: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave etaṃ bhikkhuṃ dūratova sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito āgacchantaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ duddassikaṃ okoṭimakaṃ yebhuyyena bhikkhūnaṃ paribhūtarūpanti.
ud7.5:4.1: eso bhikkhave bhikkhu mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo na ca sā samāpatti sulabharūpā yā tena bhikkhunā asamāpannapubbā
ud7.5:4.2: yassa catthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
ud7.5:5.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
